objectSelection.moveObject: Arrow keys or WASD: Move selected object

help.toggleMotionTrails: Toggle motion trails that show object paths.

objectSelection.selectSource: Press the S key to select the sound source for movement with arrow keys or WASD keys.
objectSelection.selectObserver: Press the O key to select the observer for movement with arrow keys or WASD keys.
objectSelection.moveObject: Use arrow keys or WASD keys to move the currently selected object in any direction.

controls.pauseResume: Press Space to pause or resume the simulation.
controls.reset: Press the R key to reset the entire simulation to its initial state.
controls.toggleHelp: Press the H key to show or hide this help dialog.

adjust.frequency: Press + or - to increase or decrease the emitted sound frequency.
adjust.soundSpeed: Press , (comma) or . (period) to increase or decrease the speed of sound.

scenarioKeys.freePlay: Use number keys 0-6 to load different scenarios: 0 for free play, 1 for source approaching, 2 for source receding, 3 for observer approaching, 4 for observer receding, 5 for same direction motion, and 6 for perpendicular motion.
scenarioKeys.sourceApproaching: Press 1 to see the source approaching a stationary observer.
scenarioKeys.sourceReceding: Press 2 to see the source moving away from a stationary observer.
scenarioKeys.observerApproaching: Press 3 to see the observer approaching a stationary source.
scenarioKeys.observerReceding: Press 4 to see the observer moving away from a stationary source.
scenarioKeys.sameDirection: Press 5 to see both objects moving in the same direction.
scenarioKeys.perpendicular: Press 6 to see objects moving perpendicular to each other.

a11y.toggleMotionTrails: Press the T key to show or hide the motion trails that track object movement.
a11y.toggleMicrophone: Press the M key to enable or disable the microphone that produces clicks.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a sound source and an observer that can be dragged around. Circular wave fronts spread out from the source, and a graph displays the emitted and observed waveforms.
screenSummary.controlArea: The controls set the emitted frequency and sound speed, choose preset scenarios, toggle the velocity arrows, line of sight, motion trails, grid, and microphone, and play or pause the simulation. A Reset All button returns the simulation to its starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Drag the source or observer, or load a scenario, then watch how their motion changes the observed frequency.

a11y.currentDetails: Emitted frequency {{emitted}} hertz, observed frequency {{observed}} hertz. The simulation is {{state}}.

controls.soundSpeedHelp: Adjust how fast sound waves travel.
controls.emittedFrequencyHelp: Adjust the frequency of the sound source.
